sliceLedger.title: Authority, current inventory and acceptance contract
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Audit exact live main and the mounted organization, tenant, location, workforce, membership, entitlement and operational consumers. Record existing behavior, gaps, protected paths and source-linked evidence. Publish the complete approved Mission29 plan and acceptance ledger through the normal source lane. No runtime change in this slice.

sliceLedger.title: Canonical organization/location identity contracts
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define immutable identities, explicit relationships, duplicate/unknown handling and provenance while preserving Mission20's company and Business Profile authorities. Any additive persistence includes complete compatibility, migration and rollback disposition. No automatic adoption or reassignment of old records.

sliceLedger.title: Authenticated enterprise context
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Resolve exact active actor/session/membership and selectable location context on the server. Test foreign actors, forged locations, stale context, revoked membership, omitted scope and simultaneous sessions. Existing single-location accounts retain their established behavior.

sliceLedger.title: Location lifecycle and historical scope
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define reviewed creation, activation, deactivation, naming and correction behavior with optimistic concurrency and immutable history. Record relocation/transfer as an explicit governed transition; do not silently move historical jobs, customers or financial ownership.

sliceLedger.title: Mounted location selection and navigation
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Add a coherent accessible location context to relevant existing company surfaces. Show current scope, loading, unavailable, empty and recovery states. Scope switching cannot leak cached records or alter an unrelated active workflow.

sliceLedger.title: Architecture persistence and boundary validation
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Prove repository reload, restart, concurrent changes, forced tenant/location isolation, rollback and upgrade compatibility with actual disposable PostgreSQL and mounted HTTP consumers. Reconcile every applicable existing consumer before Part2.

sliceLedger.title: Versioned enterprise capability contract
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Inventory exact accepted operations and define explicit capability/operation/scope mappings. Preserve earlier fixed matrices and vocabulary; no fuzzy aliases, wildcard grants or silent elevation of an existing role.

sliceLedger.title: Custom-role definitions and lifecycle
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Persist versioned bounded role definitions, review state and active/revoked state. Prevent unknown capabilities, privilege escalation, self-elevation and role-definition races; previous versions remain attributable.

sliceLedger.title: Scoped assignment and membership resolution
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Implement actor-specific role assignments and location/region/record scopes with exact current membership checks. Test grant, expiry, revocation, cross-session and concurrent assignment behavior. Delegated assignments never expand their granting authority.

sliceLedger.title: Delegation and approval governance
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define explicit bounded delegation, approval thresholds, separation of duties and self-approval restrictions for operations whose existing contracts support them. A threshold or enterprise role cannot waive an upstream approval or effect gate. Unsupported combinations deny.

sliceLedger.title: SSO/MFA assurance policy and adapter boundary
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Implement provider-independent assurance requirements, exact session evidence, expiry, step-up and local controlled adapter tests. Preserve existing safe access and recovery. Actual identity-provider account setup or live federation remains separately authorized and unclaimed until demonstrated.

sliceLedger.title: Revocation, ownership recovery and audit
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Make grants, revocations, ownership-sensitive changes and bounded recovery attributable and concurrency-safe. Define stale-session and in-flight-operation behavior; never claim cancellation or external effect reversal without evidence.

sliceLedger.title: Permissions administration experience and complete gate
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Provide accessible role/assignment/policy review with clear consequences, denied states, evidence and recovery. Validate actual mounted enforcement, real SQL isolation and negative capability matrices across the whole Part2 scope.

sliceLedger.title: Region definitions and authorized membership
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Version region/location mappings with explicit effective state, overlap rules and authorized visibility. A regional grouping is not a new tenant or access grant.

sliceLedger.title: Canonical regional read model
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Aggregate only records the actor may read. Pin source versions and expose coverage, partial/unavailable states, time zones, units, currencies and cutoff rules. Avoid double counting overlapping regions or repeated source records.

sliceLedger.title: Regional explanations and comparisons
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Reuse Mission25/26 learning and forecasting evidence without recalculating or asserting unsupported causality. Separate actuals, forecasts, assumptions and stale/insufficient evidence; retain authorized location drilldown.

sliceLedger.title: Regional workspace and navigation
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Render accessible comparison, filters, source explanations and location handoffs with honest loading, empty, partial, denied, stale and recovery states. Never reveal inaccessible locations through counts or errors.

sliceLedger.title: Regional correctness and isolation gate
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Execute independent aggregation counterexamples, overlap/missing-data cases, time-zone boundaries, permission revocation, mounted HTTP and actual PostgreSQL checks. No cross-company learning or data pooling is implied.

sliceLedger.title: Franchise relationship and authority model
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define network, franchisor, franchisee, company and location relationships as explicit versioned records. Do not infer legal ownership, contractual rights or access from a business relationship or brand.

sliceLedger.title: Participation and delegated visibility
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Implement exact governed participation, membership and capability scopes. Each company's authorization remains required for its records; absence or revocation denies reads, reports and operations.

sliceLedger.title: Shared configuration proposals and adoption
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Permit bounded authorized templates or policy proposals with provenance, version pinning and explicit local adoption. A network proposal never silently changes a franchisee's pricing, finance, workforce, automation or communications.

sliceLedger.title: Change, revocation and offboarding
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Preserve historical evidence and isolate current access when participation or delegation changes. Test stale sessions, partial revocation, concurrent administration and safe recovery without destructive data transfer or deletion.

sliceLedger.title: Franchise administration and whole-part gate
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Provide company-scoped administration, explanations and audit history. Validate all boundaries through mounted consumers, actual SQL and adversarial multi-company fixtures; no network-wide private-data access by default.

sliceLedger.title: Reporting definitions and evidence contract
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Inventory canonical measures and define scope, coverage, date/cutoff, time zone, currency, freshness, lineage and uncertainty for each report. Preserve Mission24–27 calculation and financial truth.

sliceLedger.title: Bounded report queries and comparisons
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Implement permission-filtered queries, grouping, pagination and location/region comparisons with deterministic limits. Prove duplicate suppression, partial coverage and stable source identity under concurrent updates.

sliceLedger.title: Saved report definitions
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Version authorized report settings and scope references without persisting a broad access grant or treating an old snapshot as current. Re-evaluate permissions whenever a saved report is opened.

sliceLedger.title: Explicit exports and disclosure controls
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Add bounded user-requested exports with exact scope, attribution and current permission checks. Preserve spreadsheet/content safety and sensitive-data minimization. No automatic external email, scheduled recipient or provider delivery is introduced.

sliceLedger.title: Enterprise reporting experience and gate
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Provide accessible reports, source drilldown and export feedback with partial/unavailable/denied/recovery states. Independently verify calculations, real SQL, mounted HTTP, cache isolation and readable output across authorized roles.

sliceLedger.title: Scoped branding configuration and assets
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Persist versioned authorized display branding and validate uploaded/referenced assets with safe type, size, URL and rendering boundaries. Never allow script/style injection, foreign-tenant assets or credential-bearing URLs.

sliceLedger.title: Shared branded rendering and fallback
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Apply branding consistently through the shared shell and applicable existing surfaces. Preserve accessible contrast, responsive layouts, system/error states, safe fallback and canonical tenant context; no parallel product logic.

sliceLedger.title: Domain and communications identity boundaries
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define explicit domain/brand claims, verification state, account recovery and disclosure ownership. Domain/DNS/certificate provisioning and sender/provider changes remain separately authorized operations; unverified branding cannot authorize a domain or recipient identity.

sliceLedger.title: White-label acceptance and recovery gate
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Verify cross-tenant isolation, unsafe content denial, cache/version transitions, branding rollback and full light/dark desktop/mobile renders. Legal/disclosure content and founder visual approval remain separate.

sliceLedger.title: Versioned API and capability inventory
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define the exact initial API surface from accepted enterprise use cases and canonical resources. Record methods, schemas, errors, pagination, versioning, scope and exclusions. Do not invent new operational effects merely to fill an API catalogue.

sliceLedger.title: Principal, credential and session authority
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Define bounded machine/user principals and locally test issuance/rotation/revocation semantics without exposing secrets or creating production credentials. Enforce exact tenant, actor, grant, audience, expiry and capability scope; possession alone cannot broaden access.

sliceLedger.title: Authorized read and report endpoints
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Mount bounded canonical read/report operations with pagination, current permission checks, cache controls, error minimization and deterministic limits. Test field-level and record-level disclosure, foreign identifiers and scope omission.

sliceLedger.title: Explicit mutation handoffs and idempotency
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Expose only already-authorized canonical mutations whose existing acceptance contracts are satisfied. Preserve actor attribution, currentness, approval, concurrency, idempotency and recovery. External provider, money and destructive effects remain unavailable without separate authority.

sliceLedger.title: Integration governance and extension contracts
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Govern connector identity, granted scope, source mapping, provenance, freshness, revocation and observed outcomes. Local controlled adapters prove contracts only; no real connector/provider calls, background synchronization or outbound webhook delivery is enabled by this slice.

sliceLedger.title: API documentation and whole-part acceptance
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Deliver exact examples, schemas and failure/recovery semantics plus actual mounted HTTP/SQL tests, adversarial authorization, bounded-load and compatibility checks. Publish provider-readiness gaps truthfully rather than describing adapters as live integrations.

sliceLedger.title: Complete authority and inventory reconciliation
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Reconcile all44 planned slice identities, accepted sources, migrations, mounted consumers, documentation and unclaimed gates against exact main. Identify every unfinished or inconsistent accepted requirement.

sliceLedger.title: Actual PostgreSQL, isolation and concurrency campaign
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Run the complete applicable enterprise and retained regression corpus in fresh disposable role-separated databases. Prove persistence/restart, RLS, role revocation, shared-scope denial, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and recovery with non-vacuous adversarials.

sliceLedger.title: Mounted journeys, failure and recovery
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Exercise end-to-end company/location/role/region/franchise/report/branding/API journeys through actual consumers, including partial evidence, stale authority, outages, denied actions and recovery. No private production writes are used as test fixtures.

sliceLedger.title: Shared rendering, accessibility and demo parity
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Validate genuine Chrome and Playwright WebKit, desktop/mobile, light/dark, keyboard/focus and native pointer/touch behavior where relevant. Use shared engines with isolated fictional sources; retain Mission31's separate public guided-simulation scope. Physical devices/manual AT/founder approval remain distinct.

sliceLedger.title: Security, bounded performance and operational readiness
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Audit sensitive-data exposure, privilege boundaries, resource limits, migration compatibility, operational observability and documented recovery. Report exact environment and limits; local load tests are not production SLA or disaster-restore evidence.

sliceLedger.title: Final independent audit and release ledger
sliceLedger.acceptanceBoundary: Complete a fresh isolated full-history whole-scope exact-head audit with zero P0–P3, same-writer additive corrections and full new audit after any SHA change. Complete normal exact-head GitHub review, guarded normal merge, required fresh backup/standing rotation, one automatic deployment, exact commit/image/startup and authorized read-only production reconciliation/health/render checks. Publish the truthful final source-linked ledger and all separate unavailable evidence.
